```shiploop-state
{
  "evidence_refs": ["Original request, S1–S2", "Exercise context: empty repository and unattended intake"],
  "headline": "Intake established the service outcome, delivery boundary, and recorded defaults.",
  "outcome": "done",
  "summary": "S1 — Fact: deliver a small Python HTTP service in which organisers create events with seat capacities and people reserve seats; the consumers are HTTP clients acting as organisers or attendees. Fact: the repository is empty, no prior run or deployed target is named, and this stage implements nothing. Assumption, recorded default: deliver source code in the run’s checkout; an isolated checkout remains at its snapshot until final return, when the outcome becomes visible there; a deployed outcome would exist only after release to a separately established target. Interaction questions, answered by recorded defaults: clients are anonymous and no runtime identity or authentication is assumed, ruling out organiser ownership and per-person reservation limits; each reservation takes one seat, with no cancellation assumed; event data and remaining capacity are shared among clients of one running service, held in memory until that process ends, and are visible to those clients; no personal data is collected or hidden, ruling out private attendee records and persistence across restarts or processes. These defaults unblock the API and state model; discovery must first establish any runtime facilities or existing requirements before replacing them. Capacity validation and simultaneous reservations are risks to address so reservations cannot exceed the seat count. Discovery, using the workspace and available Python runtime as leads, must establish available dependencies and execution conventions before selecting implementation details; that choice blocks implementation, not intake. No team, channel, internal site, private repository, owner, or deployment locator is identified in the request; any later locator is a lead until verified, and sensitive locators belong only in an authorized private store, never in committed KNOWLEDGE/. S2 — Fact: include tests for the requested service; discovery must first establish the available test tooling, and the recorded default is to use Python’s standard library if no project convention or dependency is found, unblocking test implementation. Tests and their results become visible with the returned checkout."
}
```
